
        ORG #8000

        CALL #0D6B
        LD A,2
        CALL #1601
        CALL PRINT
        DB "TESTING...",#0D,0

        LD A,#BE
        LD HL,#BF00
        LD DE,#BF01
        LD BC,#0100
        LD (HL),A
        LDIR
        LD L,A
        LD H,A
        LD (HL),#C3
        LD HL,INTP
        LD (#BEBF),HL
        INC A
        DI
        LD I,A
        IM 2
        LD B,100

CHI
        EI
XXX     LD A,I
        INC B
        DJNZ CHI

NOEMUL  CALL PRINT
        DB "NO 'EI' BUG",#0D,0
        JR CONT

SAYEMUL CALL PRINT
        DB "'EI' BUG PRESENT",#0D,0

CONT    EI
        LD B,100
PEPOBUG LD A,I
        JP PO,SAYPO
        INC B
        EI
        DJNZ PEPOBUG

        CALL PRINT
        DB "NO 'LD A,I' BUG",#0D,0
        JR EXIT

SAYPO   CALL PRINT
        DB "'LD A,I' BUG PRESENT",#0D,0

EXIT    IM 1
        EI
        XOR A
KL      IN A,(#FE)
        OR #E0
        INC A
        JR Z,KL
        RET



PRINT   POP HL
CONP    LD A,(HL)
        INC HL
        OR A
        JR Z,ENDP
        RST #10
        JR CONP
ENDP    JP (HL)


INTP    POP DE
        LD HL,XXX
        EX AF,AF
        XOR A
        SBC HL,DE
        JP Z,SAYEMUL
        DEC B
        EX AF,AF
        EX DE,HL
        JP (HL)
